blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — Seven people, including two minors, were rushed to a hospital after the vehicle they were riding in plunged down a slope in Barangay Salud Mitra here on Saturday (Nov. 14). The driver’s wife said nine people were aboard the vehicle and were on their way back to their hotel when the accident happened.
